name: Usoro Agent Ọtụtụ (Multi-Agent Systems)
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ ị nwere ike ime ka ọ na-arụ onwe ya, ikpebi ma ọ chọrọ otu agent ma ọ bụ otu agent ọtụtụ, site n'iji nnwale iwe mmadụ n'ọrụ, ya na ihe kpatara ya n'otu ahịrịokwu maka ọrụ ọ bụla

Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ chọrọ otu agent ọtụtụ, ịhọrọ ụkpụrụ (pipeline, orchestrator na ndị ọrụ, ma ọ bụ onye na-ede na onye nyocha) ma see otu ọrụ si agafe n'etiti agent, na-akpọ aha ihe na-agafe n'akụ ọ bụla
Maka agent ọ bụla nọ n'otu ahụ, ide prompt ọrụ (role prompt) na ụdị nnyefe JSON, nwere otu ọrụ maka agent ọ bụla na ndepụta nlele onye nyocha a pụrụ ịlele
N'ime koodu Python gị, idebe ọrụ otu ahụ n'otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke naanị koodu gị na-emelite, na-edekọ state ahụ mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gachara
Mgbe e nyere gị loop onye na-ede na onye nyocha, itinye oke ugboro ma nyefe mmadụ ọrụ a na-edozighị, na-akwụsị na needs_human n'ime ugboro 3 opekata elu

Mgbe e nyere gị otu ihe nnwale ahụ, itụnyere otu ahụ na otu agent (baseline) n'ịdị mma na n'ọnụ ọgụgụ oku model, na-eji otu ndepụta nlele ahụ tụọ akara ha abụọ ma na-ahọrọ nke dị mfe mgbe akara ha hara nhata

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Mgbe otu agent zuru ezu, na mgbe ọ na-ezughị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kpebie ma ọrụ chọrọ karịa otu agent.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ ị nwere ike ime ka ọ na-arụ onwe ya, ị ga-enwe ike ikpebi ma ọ chọrọ otu agent ma ọ bụ otu agent ọtụtụ, site n'iji nnwale iwe mmadụ n'ọrụ, ya na ihe kpatara ya n'otu ahịrịokwu maka ọrụ ọ bụla.
Bido n'otu agent. Agent ọ bụla agbakwunyere na-atụkwasị oku model (ego na oge), nnyefe (ebe ozi nwere ike ifu) na ihe ndị ọzọ a ga-anwale. Ọtụtụ ọrụ dị ka ha chọrọ otu agent ọtụtụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'otu agent nwere ezigbo prompt na ezigbo ngwaọrụ.
Chee maka karịa otu agent mgbe: ọrụ ahụ nwere nka dị iche iche n'ụzọ doro anya (nchọcha, wee ide ihe, wee ilele); otu prompt na-adị ogologo nke ukwuu ma na-agbagwoju anya; ị chọrọ nlele kwụụrụ onwe ya, n'ihi na onye nyocha nwere ntụziaka ọhụrụ na-ahụ mperi onye na-ede hapụrụ; ma ọ bụ akụkụ nwere ike ịrụ n'otu oge.
Nnwale bara uru: ọ bụrụ na ị ga-ewe mmadụ abụọ dị iche iche n'ọrụ maka ya, agent abụọ nwere ike inye aka. Ọ bụrụ na otu onye nwere ike ime ya site na ndepụta nlele, otu agent nwere ndepụta nlele nwere ike ka mma.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Usoro agent ọtụtụ (multi-agent system): ọtụtụ AI agent, nke ọ bụla nwere ọrụ ya, na-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ n'otu ọrụ.
- Nnyefe (handoff): inyefe ọrụ na ozi site n'otu agent gaa n'agent ọzọ.
- Ọnụ ahịa mgbakwunye (overhead): ego na mbọ mgbakwunye nke otu nhazi na-atụkwasị.
Nwaa ugbu a: Depụta ọrụ atọ ị nwere ike ime ka ha na-arụ onwe ha. Maka nke ọ bụla, dee "otu agent" ma ọ bụ "otu agent ọtụtụ" na otu ahịrịokwu na-akọwa ihe kpatara ya, site n'iji nnwale iwe mmadụ n'ọrụ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikpebi mgbe ọrụ chọrọ n'ezie karịa otu agent.

check.q: Gịnị bụ nnwale iwe mmadụ n'ọrụ?
options: Ịjụ ma mmadụ ga-agafe ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ
Ịnwale ma ụlọ ọrụ nwere ike iwe model n'ọrụ
Ịjụ ma ị ga-ewe mmadụ abụọ dị iche iche n'ọrụ maka ọrụ a
Ịgụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ngwaọrụ ọrụ chọrọ
check.why: Ọ bụrụ na ị gaghị ewe mmadụ abụọ, otu agent na-ezukarị.

check.q: Ọrụ bụ ịhazi ozi n'ụdị anọ site na ndepụta nlele. Gịnị ka ị ga-ewu?
options: Otu agent nwere ntụziaka doro anya
Otu agent anọ, otu maka ụdị ọ bụla
Orchestrator nwere ndị ọrụ
Onye na-ede na onye nyocha
check.why: Ọrụ dị mfe, doro anya, achọghị ego mgbakwunye na nnyefe nke otu agent ọtụtụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Ụkpụrụ a na-ahụkarị: pipeline, orchestrator, onye nyocha
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Họrọ ụkpụrụ agent ọtụtụ dabara ọrụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ chọrọ otu agent ọtụtụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ ụkpụrụ (pipeline, orchestrator na ndị ọrụ, ma ọ bụ onye na-ede na onye nyocha) ma see otu ọrụ si agafe n'etiti agent, na-akpọ aha ihe na-agafe n'akụ ọ bụla.
Pipeline: agent na-arụ ọrụ n'usoro a kara aka, nke ọ bụla na-enyefe nke na-esote ihe o mepụtara, dị ka ahịrị nrụpụta n'ụlọ ọrụ: nchọcha, wee ide ihe, wee ịhazi ya. Ọ dị mfe iwu na ịchọta mperi ya, n'ihi na ị na-ama mgbe niile onye ga-eme ihe ọzọ.
Orchestrator na ndị ọrụ: otu agent (orchestrator) na-ekewa ebumnuche ahụ n'akụkụ, na-enye agent ọrụ (worker) ọ bụla otu akụkụ, wee jikọta nsonaazụ ha. Ọ na-agbanwe agbanwe, mana orchestrator nwere ike ikewa ọrụ ahụ nke ọjọọ, nnwere onwe karịa pụtakwara ihe karịa a ga-elele.
Onye na-ede na onye nyocha: otu agent na-emepụta ihe, nke abụọ na-ekpe ya ikpe site na ndepụta nlele, ma ọ bụ nabata ya ma ọ bụ zighachi ya ya na ihe kpatara ya. Nke a bụ ụkpụrụ kacha baa uru maka ndị mbido n'ihi na ọ na-atụkwasị nlele ịdị mma kwụụrụ onwe ya. Ọ chọrọ oke ugboro ka ha abụọ ghara ịrụ ụka ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Pipeline: agent na-arụ ọrụ n'usoro a kara aka, nke ọ bụla na-enyefe nke na-esote ọrụ.
- Orchestrator: agent na-ekewa ebumnuche n'ọrụ ma na-enye agent ndị ọzọ ha.
- Agent nyocha (reviewer): agent na-elele ọrụ agent ọzọ site n'iwu doro anya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Maka ọrụ "otu agent ọtụtụ" site na Nkuzi 1, see agent ndị ahụ dị ka igbe nwere akụ (n'akwụkwọ dị mma). Kpọọ aha ụkpụrụ ọ bụ na ihe na-agafe n'akụ ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhọrọ n'etiti pipeline, orchestrator nwere ndị ọrụ, na onye na-ede nwere onye nyocha.

check.q: Gịnị ka orchestrator na-eme n'ụkpụrụ orchestrator na ndị ọrụ?
options: Na-elele ihe mbụ ọ bụla site na ndepụta nlele
Na-ekewa ebumnuche ma na-enye ndị ọrụ akụkụ
Na-echekwa faịlụ na diski
Na-arụ naanị na njedebe
check.why: Orchestrator na-ekewa ọrụ ma na-enyefe agent ọrụ akụkụ ya.

check.q: Ọrụ gị na-aga mgbe niile: nchọcha, wee ide ihe, wee ịhazi ya, n'usoro ahụ. Kedu ụkpụrụ dabara?
options: Onye na-ede na onye nyocha
Orchestrator na ndị ọrụ
Enweghị ụkpụrụ; jiri chatbot atọ
Pipeline
check.why: Usoro nzọụkwụ a kara aka bụ pipeline, ọ dịkwa mfe ịchọta mperi ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ide ọrụ na nnyefe
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee prompt ọrụ maka agent ọ bụla na ụdị nnyefe n'etiti ha.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Maka agent ọ bụla nọ n'otu ahụ, ị ga-enwe ike ide prompt ọrụ (role prompt) na ụdị nnyefe JSON, nwere otu ọrụ maka agent ọ bụla na ndepụta nlele onye nyocha a pụrụ ịlele.
Agent ọ bụla na-enweta system prompt mkpụmkpụ nke ya: onye ọ bụ, otu ọrụ ya, ngwaọrụ ya (naanị ihe ọ chọrọ), na ụdị ihe ọ na-eweghachi. Onye na-ede achọghị ndepụta nlele onye nyocha zuru ezu; onye nyocha achọghị ngwaọrụ ide ihe ma ọlị.
Nnyefe bụ ozi na-agafe n'etiti agent. Mee ka ọ hazie nke ọma, ọ bụghị mkparịta ụka: {"draft": "...", "facts_used": [...]} site n'onye na-ede gaa n'onye nyocha, na {"decision": "approve" ma ọ bụ "revise", "reasons": [...]} azụ. Nnyefe a haziri ahazi na-eme ka o doo anya ihe e nyefere ma dị mfe ka koodu lelee ya.
Nye onye nyocha ndepụta nlele, ọ bụghị mmetụta. "Ọ dị mma?" na-enweta nkwenye. "Eziokwu ọ bụla ọ dị na mpempe eziokwu ahụ? Ọ na-erughị okwu 80? Ọ na-ezere okwu best na guaranteed?" na-enweta ezi nlele.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee prompt ọrụ maka agent ọ bụla: ọrụ ya, otu ọrụ, ngwaọrụ, ụdị ihe ọ na-eweghachi.
- Nye agent ọ bụla naanị ngwaọrụ ọ chọrọ.
- Kọwaa nnyefe dị ka JSON nwere igodo (keys) a kara aka.
- Dee ndepụta nlele onye nyocha dị ka ajụjụ ee/mba.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Prompt ọrụ (role prompt): system prompt na-enye otu agent ọrụ ya na iwu ya.
- Ndepụta nlele (checklist): ndepụta nlele ee/mba doro anya a na-eji ekpe ọrụ ikpe.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee prompt ọrụ onye na-ede, prompt ọrụ onye nyocha nwere ndepụta nlele nwere ihe 3, na ụdị nnyefe JSON abụọ ahụ maka usoro ọrụ ikpeazụ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide prompt ọrụ na nnyefe a haziri ahazi maka otu agent ọtụtụ.

check.q: Gịnị kwesịrị ịdị na prompt ọrụ?
options: Otu ọrụ agent ahụ, ngwaọrụ ya na ụdị ihe ọ na-eweghachi
Ntụziaka agent ọ bụla ọzọ
Igodo API gị
Ndepụta ọrụ niile gara aga
check.why: Prompt ọrụ na-eme ka agent ọ bụla lekwasị anya n'ọrụ ya na ụdị ya.

check.q: A gwara onye nyocha gị "Lelee ma ihe mbụ ahụ dị mma." Gịnị ka ị ga-agbanwe?
options: Ọ dịghị ihe, ọ dị mkpụmkpụ
Nye ya ngwaọrụ ide ihe ka o dozie ihe mbụ
Dochie ya na ndepụta nlele nwere ajụjụ doro anya ọ nwere ike ịza ee ma ọ bụ mba
Hapụ ya ka o kpebie iwu nke ya
check.why: Ajụjụ nyocha na-edoghị anya na-eduga na nkwenye dị mfe nke ukwuu; ndepụta nlele na-enye ezi nlele.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Iwu na ịnwale otu agent

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: State a na-ekekọrịta: otu ebe maka ọrụ ahụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Debe ọrụ otu agent n'otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke agent ọ bụla na-agụ site na ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ime koodu Python gị, ị ga-enwe ike idebe ọrụ otu ahụ n'otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke naanị koodu gị na-emelite, na-edekọ state ahụ mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gachara.
State a na-ekekọrịta (shared state) bụ otu ebe ọrụ otu ahụ na-ebi, nke koodu gị nwe, ọ bụghị agent ọ bụla. Na Python, dictionary na-arụ ọrụ: state = {'facts': FACTS, 'draft': None, 'reviews': [], 'round': 0, 'status': 'drafting'}.
Agent ọ bụla na-enweta naanị akụkụ ọ chọrọ ma na-eweghachi nnyefe; koodu gị na-elele nnyefe ahụ ma na-emelite state. Onye na-ede na-agụ eziokwu na nyocha ikpeazụ; onye nyocha na-agụ eziokwu na ihe mbụ. Ọ dịghị agent na-agbanwe state ozugbo.
Nke a na-edebe eziokwu n'otu ebe, na-eme ka ndekọ dị mfe (chekwaa state mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gachara), ma na-egbochi agent ịgafe nnomi na-adị iche nwayọọ nwayọọ. Ọ bụrụ na ihe otu agent mepụtara adịghị mma, koodu gị nwere ike ịjụ ya tupu ọ ruo agent na-esote.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mepụta dictionary state nwere ubi (field) ọ bụla otu ahụ chọrọ.
- Nye agent ọ bụla naanị ubi ndị ọ chọrọ.
- Lelee nnyefe ọ bụla na koodu tupu imelite state.
- Chekwaa nnomi state na ndekọ mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gachara.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- State a na-ekekọrịta (shared state): otu ndekọ ọrụ otu agent nke koodu na-edebe, nke agent ọ bụla na-agụ site na ya.
- Ndịiche nwayọọ (drift): mgbe nnomi ozi na-adị iche n'ibe ha nwayọọ nwayọọ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mepụta dictionary state maka ọrụ ikpeazụ. Dee function abụọ, run_writer(state) na run_reviewer(state), nke ọ bụla na-akpọ ask_model na prompt ọrụ ya ma na-eweghachi JSON a gụpụtara, n'agbanweghị state n'onwe ha.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike idebe ọrụ usoro agent ọtụtụ n'otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke koodu gị na-achịkwa.

check.q: Gịnị bụ state a na-ekekọrịta n'usoro agent ọtụtụ?
options: Ndetu nzuzo agent ọ bụla
Otu ebe, nke koodu gị nwe, na-ejide ọrụ otu ahụ
Ncheta model n'etiti ụbọchị
Okwuntughe a na-ekekọrịta
check.why: Otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke koodu gị na-emelite na-eme ka agent niile na-arụ ọrụ site n'otu eziokwu.

check.q: Onye na-ede na onye nyocha nwe nnomi ihe mbụ nke ha, nnomi ndị ahụ amalitekwa ịdị iche. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Hapụ agent ọ bụla ka o melite state ozugbo
Tinye agent nke atọ ka o jikọta ha
Leghara ya anya ma ọ bụrụ na azịza ikpeazụ dị mma
Debe otu state a na-ekekọrịta nke naanị koodu gị na-emelite mgbe o lelechara nnyefe ọ bụla
check.why: Nnomi dị iche na-adị iche nwayọọ nwayọọ; otu state a lelere na-egbochi ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịkwụsị loop na idebe mmadụ n'ọkwa onye isi
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Tinye oke ugboro na nnyefe mmadụ na loop onye na-ede na onye nyocha.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị loop onye na-ede na onye nyocha, ị ga-enwe ike itinye oke ugboro ma nyefe mmadụ ọrụ a na-edozighị, na-akwụsị na needs_human n'ime ugboro 3 opekata elu.
Agent abụọ nwere ike ịga n'ihu ruo mgbe ebighị ebi: onye nyocha na-ahụ ihe mgbe niile, onye na-ede na-agbanwe ihe mgbe niile. Tinye MAX_ROUNDS = 3. Ọ bụrụ na onye nyocha anabataghị ya ka ọ na-erule mgbe ahụ, kwụsị na status 'needs_human' ma gosi ihe mbụ ikpeazụ na ihe kpatara ya.
Lezie anya maka ọdịda otu agent abụọ ọzọ. Ịkwado n'eleghị anya (rubber-stamping): onye nyocha na-anabata ihe niile, ọtụtụ mgbe n'ihi na ndepụta nlele ya edoghị anya. Ping-pong: onye na-ede na-edozi otu nsogbu ma weghachi nsogbu ochie. Gụọ ndekọ ahụ maka ha abụọ.
Debe mmadụ n'ọkwa onye isi n'ihe a rụpụtara. Otu ahụ na-emepụta ihe mbụ na nyocha; mmadụ na-anabata ihe ọ bụla a ga-ebipụta, zipu ma ọ bụ jiri mee mkpebi. Agent karịa anaghị ewepụ mkpa ebe nlele ahụ; ha na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa karịa.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Tinye MAX_ROUNDS.
- Loop: onye na-ede na-ede ihe mbụ, onye nyocha na-ekpebi.
- Ọ bụrụ approve: status 'approved', kwụsị.
- Ọ bụrụ revise: nyeghachi onye na-ede ihe kpatara ya.
- N'oke ahụ: status 'needs_human', gosi ihe mbụ na ihe kpatara ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ugboro (round): otu okirikiri nke ide ihe mbụ na nyocha.
- Ịkwado n'eleghị anya (rubber-stamping): ịnabata ihe niile n'enyochaghị ya n'ezie.
- Nnyefe mmadụ (escalation): inyefe mmadụ nsogbu mgbe usoro ahụ na-enweghị ike idozi ya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee loop onye na-ede na onye nyocha nwere MAX_ROUNDS = 3. Nwalee ya na mpempe eziokwu ebe o yiri ka onye na-ede ga-ekwubiga okwu ókè. Wee nwalee oke ahụ site n'ime ka ndepụta nlele onye nyocha ghara ikwe omume ("under 5 words") ma hụ na ọ kwụsịrị na needs_human.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkwụsị ping-pong agent site n'oke ugboro ma nyefe mmadụ ọrụ a na-edozighị.

check.q: Gịnị bụ ping-pong na loop onye na-ede na onye nyocha?
options: Idozi otu nsogbu na-eweghachi nsogbu ochie, ugboro ugboro
Onye nyocha na-anabata ihe mbụ ọ bụla
Agent abụọ na-arụ n'otu oge
Loop dị ngwa nke na-agwụ n'otu ugboro
check.why: Ping-pong bụ azụ na azụ na-adịghị njedebe, ọ bụ ya mere loop ahụ ji chọọ oke ugboro.

check.q: Onye nyocha anabatabeghị mgbe ugboro 3 gachara. Gịnị ka usoro ahụ kwesịrị ime?
options: Nabata ihe mbụ ikpeazụ n'agbanyeghị
Malitegharịa site n'ugboro 1

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Otu agent ọtụtụ ọ ka otu agent mma? Ịnwale ya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Tụnyere usoro agent ọtụtụ na otu agent n'otu nnwale ahụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị otu ihe nnwale ahụ, ị ga-enwe ike itụnyere otu ahụ na otu agent (baseline) n'ịdị mma na n'ọnụ ọgụgụ oku model, na-eji otu ndepụta nlele ahụ tụọ akara ha abụọ ma na-ahọrọ nke dị mfe mgbe akara ha hara nhata.
Otu agent ọtụtụ bara uru naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ka mma. Nwalee ya otu i si nwalee prompt n'ihe ọmụmụ 2: otu ihe nnwale ahụ, akara doro anya, na ntụnyere. Mee mpempe eziokwu atọ, gafere ha n'otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ na n'otu agent nwere ndepụta nlele n'ime prompt nke ya.
Tụọ akara ihe ọ bụla e mepụtara site na ndepụta nlele onye nyocha n'onwe gị (ọ bụghị site n'agent nyocha), ma gụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ oku model maka ụzọ nke ọ bụla. Oku model na-anọchi anya ego na oge.
Dee nsonaazụ ahụ n'eziokwu. Ọ bụrụ na otu agent nwetara otu akara ahụ na otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ nke oku ahụ, jiri otu agent. Ọ bụrụ na otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ jidere ezi mperi otu agent hapụrụ, oku mgbakwunye ahụ zụtaara gị ịdị mma. Azịza nke ọ bụla bụ ezigbo nsonaazụ injinia.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mee mpempe eziokwu nnwale atọ.
- Gafere nke ọ bụla n'otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ na n'otu agent.
- Tụọ akara ihe ọ bụla e mepụtara n'onwe gị site na ndepụta nlele.
- Gụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ oku model maka ụzọ nke ọ bụla.
- Dee ụzọ meriri na ihe kpatara ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Baseline: ụdị dị mfe ị na-eji atụnyere, ebe a otu agent.
- Oku model (model call): otu arịrịọ nye model; oku karịa pụtara ego na oge karịa.
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mechaa usoro onye na-ede na onye nyocha nwere state a na-ekekọrịta, nnyefe a haziri ahazi na MAX_ROUNDS = 3, gafere ya na mpempe eziokwu atọ, gafere baseline otu agent n'otu mpempe ndị ahụ, ma dee obere ntụnyere nke ịdị mma na oku model.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu obere usoro agent ọtụtụ ma gosi ma ọ ka otu agent mma.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ọrụ na ndepụta nlele doro anya Ọrụ na-agabiga n'ibe ha, ma ọ bụ onye nyocha na-ajụ naanị ma ihe mbụ ahụ dị mma. Onye na-ede na onye nyocha nwe otu ọrụ nke ọ bụla; onye nyocha na-elele eziokwu si na mpempe ahụ, na-erughị okwu 80 na enweghị okwu dị ka "best". Onye nyocha enweghị ngwaọrụ ide ihe ma na-enye ihe kpatara revise ọ bụla. Nnyefe a haziri ahazi Agent na-agafe ederede efu nke koodu apụghị ilele. Onye nyocha na-eweghachi JSON nwere approve ma ọ bụ revise na ihe kpatara ya. Koodu na-elele nnyefe ọ bụla tupu iji ya. State a na-ekekọrịta Agent na-edebe nnomi ọrụ ahụ dị iche iche. Ọrụ ahụ na-agafe n'otu dictionary state nke koodu na-emelite. E dekọrọ state ahụ mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gachara. Oke ugboro na nnyefe mmadụ Enweghị oke ugboro, ma ọ bụ loop ahụ nwere ike ịga n'ihu ebighị ebi. Ọ na-akwụsị n'ime ugboro 3 opekata elu ma bipụta ndekọ zuru ezu. Ọrụ a na-edozighị na-akwụsị na needs_human ma gosi ihe mbụ na ihe kpatara ya. Ntụnyere kwụ ọtọ Enweghị baseline otu agent, ma ọ bụ e jiri ihe nnwale dị iche iche. E gafere otu mpempe eziokwu 3 ahụ n'ha abụọ, ya na ndetu e dere ede gbasara nke mere nke ọma karịa na ihe kpatara ya. E jiri otu ndepụta nlele ahụ tụọ akara ha abụọ ma gụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ oku model. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Gịnị bụ baseline n'ihe ọmụmụ a?
options: Ihe mbụ onye na-ede mere
Otu agent ị na-eji atụnyere otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ
Akara kacha ala a na-ekwe
Oke ugboro
check.why: Ịtụnyere ya na otu agent na-egosi ma otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ kwesịrị ego mgbakwunye ya.

check.q: Otu agent ọtụtụ ahụ nwetara akara dị ntakịrị elu karịa otu agent mana o ji oku model okpukpu atọ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Họrọ otu agent ọtụtụ mgbe niile, n'ihi na otu ka mma
Kwụsị ịnwale
Tinye agent ndị ọzọ iji bulie akara
Tụlee ma obere uru ahụ kwesịrị ego na oge mgbakwunye ahụ, ma dee ihe kpatara ya
check.why: Oku model na-anọchi anya ego na oge, ya mere nhọrọ ahụ na-atụle ịdị mma megide ha.
